Engineering & Construction alternative technology disruption 2026 2027 utility construction robotics prefabrication

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 Item 1 describes utility customers adding smart grid technologies and emerging technologies, plus undergrounding of critical infrastructure and new gas generation and battery storage, all as sources of continued infrastructure work for the company; no substitute technology for its services is identified in the excerpt.
findings.excerpt: in order to reliably and efficiently deliver power and in preparation for emerging technologies, utility customers are also integrating smart grid technologies into distribution systems to improve grid management and create efficiencies, and a number of utility customers continue to implement system upgrades and hardening programs in response to recurring severe weather events, including, among other things, initiatives to underground critical infrastructure.

substitute_technology.note: Two searches run; no source found describing a technology that substitutes for Quanta's services. Search results on construction robotics/prefab were generic industry pieces without verbatim excerpts. Only 2 of 4 searches used.

clues.claim: PwC analysis: AI, robotics and prefab reshaping engineering and construction; SMRs and modular battery storage moving from prototype to production.
clues.source: PwC, Building smarter: How prefab, AI, and intelligent supply chains are reshaping engineering and construction
